latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — easily edit and export film videos from raw footage, no manual editing required.

- Upload raw footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, up to 500MB) and describe your desired edits.
- Automated cloud film editing: cut, add transitions, sync music; returns 1080p MP4 downloads.
- Built-in session and credential management (auto-token with 100 free credits if needed).
- Understands prompts for uploading, exporting, checking credits or status, and timeline requests.
- Fast cloud processing; typical results in 1–2 minutes for short scenes.
- Clear feedback and error handling for unsupported files, token issues, or export failures.
